description: Check a journal entry before an agent posts it to the books. Send the lines, each with an account and a debit or a credit. Get back whether debits equal credits to the cent, both totals and the difference, and every line problem: a line with both a debit and a credit, a line with neither, an amount with more than 2 decimals, an entry with fewer than 2 lines or with only one side, and lines that look duplicated (same account, side and amount). Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/journal-entry-check). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

entry_date.description: Optional entry date, YYYY-MM-DD (echoed and signed).

account.description: Account name or number (up to 8 digits), e.g. '1000 Cash', '400100' or 'Rent expense'. Part of the signed record.

credit.description: Credit amount (0 or leave out on a debit line).

debit.description: Debit amount (0 or leave out on a credit line).

memo.description: Optional memo (your own text, echoed back).

name: journal_entry_check
title: Journal Entry Balance Check
